JEWLIF – Jüdisches Leben in Europa e. V. mit Sitz in Köln stärkt jüdisches Leben in Deutschland und Europa durch Projekte in Bildung, Wissenschaft, Kunst, Kultur und Medienkompetenz. Für Oktober bis Dezember 2026 suchen wir eine erfahrene selbstständige Fachkraft für Presse, PR und Kommunikation für projektbezogene Aufträge.

Aufgaben

Je nach Anlass vereinbaren wir mit dir einzelne Leistungspakete:

· Pressemitteilungen: Recherche, Texterstellung und Überarbeitung nach Briefing, mit Zitat des Generalsekretärs, Boilerplate und Förderhinweis sowie bis zu zwei Korrekturrunden, einschließlich einer Fassung für unsere Website. Bei Bedarf ergänzt um die Ansprache ausgewählter Redaktionen und einen kurzen Resonanzbericht.

· Pressemappen: Aufbereitung von Informationen zu JEWLIF und einzelnen Maßnahmen mit Factsheets, Hintergrundtexten, FAQ und Bildmaterial. mit geklärten Bildrechten.

· Newsletter: Sammeln von Informationen aus unseren Projekten, Redigieren der Texte sowie Auswahl und Bearbeitung passender Bilder mit geklärten Nutzungsrechten. Du setzt jede Ausgabe vollständig in unserer bestehenden Brevo-Vorlage auf und bereitest sie zur Freigabe vor.

· Social Media: Entwicklung von Redaktionsplänen sowie Text und Gestaltung einer vereinbarten Anzahl von Beiträgen, bei Bedarf einschließlich Veröffentlichung.

· Presseanfragen und Veranstaltungen: Recherche und Antwortentwürfe zu einzelnen Anfragen mit Dokumentation in einem Anfrageprotokoll sowie Vorbereitung konkreter Pressetermine mit Einladung, Ablauf, Sprechzettel und Hintergrundinformationen.

· Dokumentation: Erstellung kurzer Checklisten für Presseabläufe (Pressemitteilung, Pressetermin, Presseanfrage und Erstreaktion bei kritischer Berichterstattung) und geordnete Übergabe der erarbeiteten Materialien mit einem abschließenden Übergabegespräch.

Die Zusammenarbeit:

Umfang, Ergebnisse, Termine und Honorar stimmen wir für jedes Leistungspaket vorab miteinander ab. Du setzt die vereinbarten Leistungen eigenverantwortlich mit eigener Ausstattung um und gestaltest Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit selbst. Für Briefings, Rückfragen und Freigaben steht dir eine feste Ansprechperson zur Verfügung. Alles, was nach außen geht, gibt der Generalsekretär frei. Unser CI-Handbuch, unsere Vorlagen und Boilerplates stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

Der voraussichtliche Gesamtumfang liegt bei bis zu 36 Leistungstagen im genannten Zeitraum. Die Beauftragung erfolgt nach Bedarf und gemeinsamer Vereinbarung. Abgerechnet wird monatlich nach Tagesnachweis mit Zuordnung zu den Leistungspaketen.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in Pressearbeit, PR oder Journalismus und formulierst sicher und verständlich auf Deutsch. Du arbeitest selbstständig und kannst aussagekräftige Referenzen vorweisen. Erfahrungen mit gemeinnützigen Organisationen, eigene Kontakte zu Redaktionen sowie Kenntnisse jüdischen Lebens und der Debatte um Antisemitismus sind willkommen, ebenso Erfahrung mit Newsletter-Tools wie Brevo.

Dein Angebot:

Wir freuen uns bis zum 28. September 2026, 12 Uhr, über dein Angebot über JOIN mit:

· einem kurzen Profil (höchstens zwei Seiten) und deiner Verfügbarkeit,

· zwei Arbeitsproben und zwei Referenzprojekten mit Ansprechperson,

· deinem Stunden- und/oder Tagessatz, beim Tagessatz mit Angabe der enthaltenen Stunden,

· gerne ergänzenden Paketpreisen mit kurzer Beschreibung der enthaltenen Leistungen.

Bitte gib an, welche Aufgabenpakete du übernehmen möchtest. Preise bitten wir netto zuzüglich gegebenenfalls anfallender Umsatzsteuer anzugeben; mögliche Reise- und Nebenkosten bitte gesondert ausweisen. Fragen vorab beantwortet Rebecca Westerschulze, Bei der Auswahl berücksichtigen wir Preis, Qualität der Arbeitsproben sowie einschlägige Erfahrung und Referenzen. Ein Anspruch auf Beauftragung besteht nicht, die Kosten für die Angebotserstellung erstatten wir nicht.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 
  • It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.  
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

data.description:
Unser Mandant aus dem Raum Bielefeld ist ein international erfolgreich positioniertes, mittelständisches Produktionsunternehmen mit mehreren Auslandsgesellschaften. Im Zuge einer Neuausrichtung befindet sich auch die Finanzorganisation in einer Phase der Professionalisierung und Weiterentwicklung. Für die Gestaltung einer Group Controlling-Organisation als echter Business Partner suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die mit Herz und Hand die Konzeption vornimmt und die operative Umsetzung mitverantwortet. Mit Humor, der notwendigen Lockerheit und Überzeugung in den Themen kreieren Sie eine konstruktive und umsetzungsorientierte Atmosphäre.

Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen die aktive Führung eines kleinen Teams und entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern weiter
  • Sie optimieren die Konsolidierung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse als Basis für die integrierte Planung und den Forecasts der mittelständischen Gruppe mit in- und ausländischen Gesellschaften nach IFRS
  • Sie verantworten die kaufmännische Betreuung kleinerer Gruppengesellschaften - und führen diese als steuernder Controller
  • Sie entwickeln Analysen und Kommentierungen der Geschäftsentwicklung und übernehmen die qualifizierte Darstellung und Erläuterung von Planabweichungen als Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen
  • Sie erarbeiten die rollierende Liquiditätsplanung sowie die Bereitstellung der Daten für das Sparring mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Sie sichern den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung von Abschluss- und Planungsprozessen im neuen Konsolidierungstool mit Schnittstellen zu aktuellen ERP-Systemen
  • Sie lieben die Weiterentwicklung des abteilungsübergreifenden KPI-Monitorings als Grundlage für die strategische und operative Steuerung

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling/Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung im Controlling eines internationalen und produzierenden Unternehmens
  • Sie bringen fundierte Controlling und HGB-/ IFRS-Kenntnisse mit und bewegen sich sicher im externen und internen Rechnungswesen

data.description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

    • You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

    • Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)

  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.

data.description:
Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.

Wir glauben fest daran, dass Vielfalt die Grundlage für Innovation und Erfolg ist. Deshalb fördern wir ein offenes, respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jede Person unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder individuellen Lebenswegen entfalten kann. Unsere Unternehmenskultur zeichnet sich durch Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und einen starken Teamgeist aus. Wir bieten Dir die Flexibilität, Beruf- und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen, und schaffen Raum für persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die digitale Zukunft – und dabei zählt jede Meinung.


Darum geht's:

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest skalierbare Backend-Services auf Basis von NestJS und .NET
  • Dabei arbeitest Du aktiv in Kundenprojekten an modernen Web- und Cloud-Anwendungen für die Energiewirtschaft mit 
  • API-Schnittstellen (REST/GraphQL) werden von Dir gestaltet und externe Systeme durch Dich integriert
  • Auch in Architekturentscheidungen bringst Du Dich ein und entwickelst bestehende Services weiter
  • Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps-Prozesse (CI/CD, Tests, Deployments)
  • Neuentwicklungen werden von der Konzeption bis zum produktiven Betrieb von Dir begleitet


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du bringst ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit
  • Außerdem hast Du bereits 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung sammeln können
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in NestJS und .NET heben dich hervor
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Clean Code und Design Patterns
  • In der Entwicklung und im Betrieb von Software auf Azure-Basis hast Du Erfahrungen gesammelt
  • Dich zeichnen eine selbstständige, teamfähige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du bringst sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch mit
  • Prozesskenntnisse in der Energiewirtschaft, insbesondere Netzbetreiber sind vorteilhaft


Werde Teil unseres Teams!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams der WGI GmbH suchen wir aktuell eine/n

Senior Software Entwickler*in (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt NestJS

für anstehende Projekte und Aufgaben an unserem Standort in Berlin sowie an unseren Standorten deutschlandweit. Unsere Stellen sind sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar – ganz flexibel und vereinbar mit Deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen.

data.title: Applikations- und Softwarebetreuer*in (m/w/d)

data.description:
Welcome

Are you passionate about embedded software, industrial communication, and intelligent drive systems? Then join INVENSITY. Together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions for the next generation of industrial control and drive technologies and actively drive the digital transformation of industry.

Your contribution: You’ll develop and optimize software for modern controller platforms, variable-frequency drives, and servo drives. With your expertise in real-time communication, embedded systems, and industrial networks, you’ll lay the foundation for high-performance, reliable, and future-proof automation solutions.



What can you expect?

  • Help shape the next generation of intelligent IoT solutions by developing innovative software for open communication protocols and TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) technologies on new and existing embedded platforms
  • Bring together various technologies by integrating, validating, and continuously optimizing third-party software components and modern communication stacks
  • Work in a modern, agile development environment based on model-driven methods, which gives you the opportunity to help shape holistic solutions that go beyond individual embedded platforms
  • Take on responsibility as part of a dedicated, agile team and actively contribute to the development of high-performance, reliable, and high-quality software products
  • Benefit from collaborating in interdisciplinary and international teams, exchange ideas with experts from a wide range of disciplines, and help shape innovative technologies in a global environment
  • Personal and professional development: Grow in a technologically leading environment, build connections, and help drive innovation across a wide variety of industries


Your profile

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications and information technology, or a comparable field
  • Several years of professional experience in hardware-oriented embedded software development using C/C++ under real-time operating systems (RTOS), as well as in-depth knowledge of Python and Git-based development environments
  • In-depth knowledge of Ethernet-based communication protocols such as TCP/IP, TLS, and PTP; ideally supplemented by experience with industry standards such as IEEE 1588, TSN, and X.509
  • Knowledge of C#, SQL, GoogleTest, and Jenkins, as well as experience with Azure DevOps/Pipelines, Visual Studio Code, or modern CI/CD processes, is a plus
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex technical issues to various stakeholders in a way that is tailored to their needs, understandable, and practical
  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills




What are your benefits?

  • Structured onboarding: A clear onboarding plan, joint starting days with other new employees, and dedicated contact persons will support you from day one
  • Flexible working: Permanent employment contracts, flexible working hours, the option to work from home, part-time arrangements, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Global network: Collaboration with experts across our international locations
  • A unique working atmosphere and an appreciative corporate culture: Monthly office events, a first-name culture, short communication channels, and working towards shared goals
  • A steep learning curve: Varied responsibilities in an innovative environment, with diverse projects across different industries and clients
  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months




Good to know

Employment type: Permanent employment
Work model: Hybrid, combining remote work and office-based work
Workplace: Mannheim or Heidelberg


Your contact person

Sinja Seyfert

data.description:
Das machst du bei uns:

  • Du identifizierst spannende Unternehmen und recherchierst die relevanten Entscheider:innen für unseren B2B - Vertrieb und bereitest selbständig den Erstkontakt vor.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Sales Manager:innen durch eine erste Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Neukund:innen und identifizierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner
  • Du vereinbarst Webmeetings zwischen potenziellen Kund:innen und unseren Account Executives.
  • Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Sales Manager:innen und Account Executives zusammen und erhältst einen direkten Einblick in professionellen B2B-Sales.


Das bringst du mit:

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität immatrikuliert und möchtest uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit kannst du deine Stunden nach Absprache erhöhen.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne und fühlst dich wohl dabei, zum Telefon zu greifen und mit neuen Menschen ins Gespräch zu kommen.
  • Ein „Nein“ schreckt dich nicht ab – du bleibst motiviert, freundlich und neugierig.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, organisierst deine Aufgaben selbstständig und bleibst auch in trubeligen Phasen motiviert.
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Vertrieb, in der Neukundenakquise oder mit einem CRM wie Salesforce sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst dich auch auf Englisch gut verständigen.


Das bieten wir dir:

  • Vielfältige Aufgaben in einem motivierten Team: Unser sympathisches und kollegiales Miteinander steht im Fokus
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du kannst einen Teil deiner Arbeit flexibel aus dem Homeoffice erledigen. Da wir jedoch den Austausch vor Ort schätzen, legen wir Wert darauf, dass du regelmäßig auch in unserem Büro in Hamburg bist.
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Unser modernes Büro mit hochwertiger Ausstattung vereint stilvolles Design & innovative Technik. Zusätzlich stellen wir dir eine moderne Home-Office-Ausstattung zur Verfügung.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildung: Entfalte dein Potenzial mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erhalte exklusiven Zugang zu Lerninhalten von PINKTUM.

data.title: Trainee (m/w/d) in der energetischen Sanierung

data.description:
Deine Rolle

Wir bauen Renewa One – das zentrale System, mit dem wir die Sanierung von Gebäuden managen. Wir entwickeln radikal anders als die meisten: KI-first mit Claude Code. Der Code entsteht schnell und in großer Menge – die eigentliche Kunst liegt nicht mehr im Tippen, sondern im Beurteilen, Zusammenführen und Verantworten.


Deine Mission

  • Du entwickelst neue Features unseres Sanierungs-Management-Systems – KI-assistiert und auf Basis unserer bestehenden Architektur.
  • Du bringst Pull Requests verlässlich zum Release: reviewen, testen, Konflikte lösen und dafür geradestehen, dass nur sauberer, korrekter Code live geht.
  • Du bist die entscheidende Qualitätsinstanz für KI-generierten Code – du erkennst die subtilen Fehler, die eine grüne Pipeline nicht sichtbar macht.
  • Du hältst die Codebase konsistent und wartbar: gemeinsame Muster und ein sauberes Datenmodell statt Wildwuchs.
  • Du verantwortest den Weg von der Idee bis zum Release mit – damit Features schnell und in guter Qualität bei den Nutzern ankommen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code: Du entwickelst KI-first mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren KI-Coding-Agents) und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen. Bei uns ist das die Grundlage der Arbeit, kein Bonus.
  • Full-Stack-TypeScript mit echter Tiefe: Du bist im Frontend (React) sattelfest und kannst Backend-Code – APIs, Datenbank-Queries, Services – selbst schreiben und korrigieren. Nur so kannst du ihn wirklich beurteilen statt nur durchwinken. 
  • Urteilsvermögen fürs Merge-Gate: Du liest Pull Requests kritisch, gibst klares, konstruktives Feedback und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, was released wird. 
  • PostgreSQL & Datenmodellierung: Du verstehst Transaktionen, Indizes, Fremdschlüssel und Migrationen – und behandelst das Schema als langlebigen Contract, nicht als Wegwerfartikel.
  • Sauberes Git-Handwerk: Rebase, Merge-Konflikte, CI-Pipelines und ein Branch-basierter Workflow sind für dich Alltag.
  • Disziplin statt Ego: Du arbeitest mit den bestehenden Mustern des Teams, statt bei jedem PR deine eigene Meinung durchzudrücken.
  • Du wohnst bereits in Hamburg: Diese Stelle ist nicht remote zu besetzen. Du solltest bereits in Hamburg oder im Umland wohnen und bereit sein, mehrmals in der Woche aus unserem Büro in Winterhude zu arbeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C-Level: Um intern gut mit unseren Mitarbeitenden zu kommunizieren und ein Verständnis für ihre Wünsche und die fachlichen Ansprüche zu entwickeln, sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse notwendig. 
Schöne Extras:
  • Erfahrung mit Fly.io / Docker und der Anbindung externer APIs (z. B. CRM- oder Buchhaltungssysteme)
  • Blick für UI-Konsistenz und Design-Systeme
  • Interesse an der Bau- / Sanierungs-Domäne

About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role:

As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality function across three core areas: the quality management system, design quality assurance including software quality assurance, and supplier quality assurance including QC activities. As we approach on-market release, you will also prepare the QMS for customer facing activities including post-market surveillance and complaint handling.

This is a player-coach role: hands-on leadership rather than pure people-management. You will set direction and develop the team, but you will also write procedures, make decisions, and stay close to the product and organisation needs. You will work as a direct partner to our engineering teams and alongside our dedicated Regulatory Affairs leadership. Regulatory is not part of this role, but a function you will collaborate closely with.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership: Lead and develop our existing Quality team, instilling and maintaining a high performance culture.

  • Ensure the CoMind QMS complies with the FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820, harmonised with ISO 13485) and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, while remaining customer focused and aligned with business needs.

  • Audit Leadership: Lead our annual ISO 13485 certification audit, FDA inspection readiness and own the internal, supplier, and customer audit programmes.

  • Design Quality Assurance: Oversee design controls and design transfer to manufacturing including the DHFs and DHRs, ISO 14971 risk management, IEC 62366 useability, UDI requirement, and quality assurance across an integrated product spanning electronics, optics, and software.

  • Provide oversight and guidance on software development processes including IEC 62304 software development processes, Software as Medical Device (SaMD) classification, and FDA's SaMD/AI-ML guidance.

  • Cybersecurity: Provide oversight and guidance on cybersecurity aspects impacting product and business processes, including FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (Section 524B)

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Quality: Lead supplier qualification, supplier audits, and manufacturing quality as we build toward commercial production. Work with suppliers to ensure effective Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes are implemented. Establish processes for maintaining Device Master Records, and transfer of batch records to CoMind.

  • Post-Market Quality: Create the post-market side of the QMS from the ground up as we launch, including complaint handling, product analytics, and on-market quality processes

  • Work with the RA function to compile Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR), vigilance reporting / MDR reporting, or field corrective actions/recalls in line with EU MDR/FDA obligations.

  • Provide oversight and guidance on clinical evaluation / clinical data quality.

Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive leadership experience in Quality Assurance within an ISO 13485 environment including product design, manufacturing and commercial customer-facing operations

  • A strong track record of building and managing high-performing Quality teams.

  • Expert command of the core Quality toolkit: QMS, ISO 13485, design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, CAPA, validation, and supplier quality.

  • Experience hosting and leading audits, including annual certification audits. Preferred audit certifications (ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ-OE, RAC, Lead Auditor certification)

  • Background in medical devices, ideally complex or integrated products. Strong candidates from diagnostics, IVD or pharma will also be considered.

  • Experience in software-intensive / connected-devices

  • Working knowledge of FDA / EU MDR and UK CA regulatory frameworks

  • SaMD/software quality experience, human factors, or cybersecurity awareness

  • A hands-on operator. You are comfortable writing SOPs and making decisions yourself, not just directing others.

  • A record of staying and building - you are motivated by the journey and the chance to shape a function

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life assurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

Compensation: £120K – £140K • Offers Equity

At Octopus Energy Services, we're at the forefront of the energy revolution, committed to accelerating the global transition to a sustainable future. The widespread adoption of low carbon technologies is critical to achieving net-zero emissions and combating climate change. Our mission is to make these innovative solutions not only environmentally friendly but also as cost-effective and accessible as possible, ensuring a greener, more affordable energy landscape for everyone.

 

As a Finance Data manager, you will play a critical role in driving our business forward. You will work closely with our supply chain, commercial and operations teams to provide cleaned, up-to-date information and data-driven insights that inform business decisions and improve our competitiveness and scalability. In the role, you’ll work on some of the biggest challenges facing the organisation and leverage the latest technologies to answer these problems.


What you'll do

  • Create, maintain and optimise reporting for various different streams of cost information
  • Use dbt and create semantic layers to inform AI enabled dashboards, reports, and visualisations

About the Opportunity

In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

  • Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.

  • Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.

  • Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.

  • Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.

  • Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.

  • Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.

Must-have experience and skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.

  • Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.

  • Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.

  • A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).

  • A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.

  • Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.

  • Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.

Bonus Points

  • A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).

About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role:

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.

You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

 

What you'll own:

  • Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.

  • Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.

  • Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

  • The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Compensation Band: £65-80K OTE [60/40]

About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

This is a rare opportunity to shape how Sitecore grows through its partner ecosystem across two of its most dynamic regions. The Partner Marketing Manager owns joint marketing with Sitecore's implementation partners across EMEA and Asia Pacific, as well as our international reseller community—turning those relationships into a powerful, scalable route to market.

You will build and run co-marketing programmes that are deliberately aligned to Sitecore's core FY27 buying motions— including our market-leading CMS SitecoreAI, our AI-powered DAM and Scrunch, the best way to win AI search. Every campaign you launch will be tied to a business problem our customers are actively trying to solve, and to the pipeline and bookings that follow.

The role blends ambitious strategic thinking with confident hands-on delivery. You will work shoulder to shoulder with partners, regional sales leaders and the wider marketing organisation to extend Sitecore's reach through and with our ecosystem, and you will see the impact of your work in the pipeline, in partner momentum, and in the customers we win together. You will take on a broad and genuinely influential remit across EMEA, Asia Pacific and our international reseller network:

What You Will Do:

  • Align partner marketing to the FY27 buying motions: Translate Sitecore's buying motions into partner-ready campaigns, narratives and assets, ensuring every parent campaign is correctly aligned and consistently tracked

  • Build joint plans with EMEA and APAC implementation partners: Develop and manage ambitious quarterly marketing plans with our systems integrators and implementation partners, using multi-channel tactics—webinars, events, digital campaigns, executive roundtables—to create demand and pipeline in-region

  • Support our growing international reseller business: Design scalable, repeatable marketing programmes and campaign-in-a-box toolkits that equip resellers across international markets to generate and progress demand independently, with the messaging, enablement and support they need to succeed

  • Drive pipeline and revenue through the channel: Align every partner programme to regional sales objectives, generating new-customer leads, accelerating pipeline and contributing directly to bookings targets for Sitecore's core and new offers

  • Develop and champion partner relationships: Build trusted, energising relationships with key partners and reseller leaders. Work closely with partner account managers to spot joint opportunities, shape go-to-market programmes and keep partners engaged, informed and invested

  • Coordinate across regions and functions: Partner with Field Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Product Marketing, Campaigns and Sales across EMEA and Asia Pacific to adapt global content for partner use, respecting local market nuance while keeping messaging consistent and on-brand

  • Measure, learn and report: Track programme performance against clear KPIs, analyse results across campaigns, regions and channels to determine ROI and best practice, and share regular, insight-rich reporting with internal stakeholders and partners alike

  • Manage budget and Marketing Development Funds: Own the partner marketing budget, including MDF and co-op funds, allocating investment to the partners, markets and motions with the greatest potential for return

What You Need to Succeed:

  • A minimum of 5 years of B2B marketing experience, including direct experience with partner or channel marketing programmes in the technology or software industry

  • Experience marketing across multiple international markets—EMEA and/or Asia Pacific especially—with genuine sensitivity to cultural and market differences

  • Confidence building campaigns around solution and outcome-led themes rather than product features

  • Demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) skills

  • An analytical and data-driven mindset

Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.

  • Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.

  • Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.

  • Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.

  • Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.

  • Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.

  • Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.

  • Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.

  • Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.

  • Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

About You

  • You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.

  • You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.

  • You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.

  • You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.

  • You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.

  • Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.

  • You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.

  • You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.

  • You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.

  • You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.

  • You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.

  • Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

 

✨ Kind, curious, and low-ego designers thrive at Bumble Inc. If you’re excited to shape how people around the world form relationships and find belonging, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

About tonies:

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.


With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management
  • Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships
  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship
  • Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories
  • Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem
  • Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue)
  • Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity 
Cross-functional collaboration
  • Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction
  • Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination
  • Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. 


What we are looking for:

  • 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential
  • Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories
  • Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)
  • Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it
  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork
  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design


Why tonies?

●   Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
●   Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
●   Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.
●   Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.
●   Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.
●   Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!
●   Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.


Good to know:

Please submit your application documents in English.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

Company video

Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Orbital's next phase of growth is US-led. New York is where the go-to-market weight is moving, and hiring follows it. We are hiring a Head of Talent to own that and all hiring across the UK and US.

This is a precision function, not a volume one. Every hire is expected to raise the bar. You will be measured on the calibre of who joins, not how many.

Talent at Orbital has been built and run by a specialist embedded partner, and that engagement now hands over to a permanent in-house function. The building blocks are in place and TA is a respected function in the business: Ashby, scorecards, interview design and reporting are all live and operating. Your job is to take that function fully in-house, own it permanently, and take it from good to exceptional.

What you'll own

The strategy. The company-wide hiring plan, built with the CEO, COO and CRO from growth targets. It is your role to define how that plan gets delivered, and you will have full autonomy to do it. From team to tools to operations.

The team. A precision talent team across the US and UK. The current TA team are all experienced recruiters. Your role is to coach and develop them into a genuinely high-impact team, and to hold that standard as it grows.

The method. Orbital hires direct. Your team works search-led: they map a market, build a target list and go after named people rather than working inbound. You set that standard, and you personally run the searches where seniority or business impact demands it.

What we're looking for

A scale-up track record. You have built or materially scaled a talent function inside a VC-backed technology company through a comparable arc, roughly 100 to 300 people.

Precision over volume. Your track record is low-volume, high-calibre hiring. You can point to specific hires that changed a company's trajectory and explain exactly how you found, engaged and closed them.

GTM and Engineering depth. You have personally owned both GTM and Engineering hiring in your career and have knowledge of the UK and US markets.

Executive search craft. You have designed and run targeted headhunt processes end to end for people who were not looking: market mapping, target lists, multi-touch engagement, assessment and close. You can walk us through the process, not just the outcome.

Executive-team fluency. You hold your own on commercial strategy with a CRO, technical org design with a CTO, planning with a COO, and the talent narrative with a CEO. You operate as a peer who brings a position, not a service provider taking a brief.

Operational rigour. Forecasts hold. Pipeline reviews happen. Data in the ATS is accurate without being chased. Follow-up does not slip, and stakeholders always know where a search stands. You are detail-oriented by instinct, because precision is what wins at this level.

US and UK experience. You have run a distributed recruiting team across US and UK time zones with a single operating rhythm, one quality bar and clear accountability in both markets.

A record of raising a team's level. Not just managing one. Clear expectations, honest feedback, visible performance data, real coaching on craft.

AI literacy in practice. You already build AI into how your function works, and you can show what it changed about your team's output.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You measure yourself on requisitions filled, time-to-fill and headcount delivered above all else.
