About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director, Marketing to own the whole marketing function across demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, with accountability for pipeline contribution, the market narrative, and the marketing budget. The team is seven people across the US and UK. You will set direction, connect marketing to the commercial number, and run as one go-to-market unit with our (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

Based in London or New York, with regular travel across the US and Europe.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and lead the full marketing function: demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, including the team across the US and UK and the complete marketing budget.

  • Bring the team together with a clear marketing plan and operating rhythm, and connect the function to the commercial number.

  • Own an agreed and evidenced marketing contribution to pipeline, reported consistently and trusted by sales leadership and the board. Run the function off numbers: pipeline sourced and influenced, conversion by stage, cost per opportunity and programme return.

  • Refresh positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across marketing, sales and product, so the same story is told the same way.

  • Hold and defend the full marketing budget. Make real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, reallocate on evidence, and show what each dollar returned and what was stopped.

  • Lead and coach the team. Retain and stretch top performers, set clear expectations, and shape the team structure around the plan.

  • Build a measurably stronger share of voice in cyber risk analytics across insurance and reinsurance media, analysts, and industry events.

  • Run marketing across US and European markets. Judge where a global message holds and where it has to flex, and manage a team split across time zones without defaulting to one side.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Product, and run as one go-to-market unit with the (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

What We Look For

  • Proven marketing leadership across all three pillars: demand generation, product marketing and communications/events, with a team of comparable size and seniority. Has set the plan, allocated a budget and been held to a pipeline number.

  • Has marketed complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers in a B2B SaaS or analytics business. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs. Understands how marketing creates and accelerates enterprise pipeline rather than reporting on it.

  • International experience. Has run marketing across US and European markets and managed a team split across time zones.

  • Budget ownership. Has held and defended a full marketing budget, made real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, and can evidence return.

  • Metrics-oriented. Runs the function off numbers and is comfortable being inspected on them alongside sales. Knows the funnel numbers without looking them up and coaches the team against them. Stops what is not working quickly and moves the budget to what is.

  • Product marketing judgement. Can shape positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across sales, product and comms.

  • Commercially accountable. Volunteers for the number rather than negotiating away from it, and is as comfortable in a forecast review as in a creative one. Not precious about which activities get prioritised, and agile enough to change them as the company scales.

  • Executive credible. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to carry the CyberCube story.

  • A high accountability people leader who raises the bar on an existing team. Sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, and is respected for it.

  • Strong editorial judgment and taste. Will not ship undifferentiated content, and can tell the difference between a message that resonates with the market and one that only resonates internally.

  • Partners with Sales and Product by choice, not by process. Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.

  • Based in London, with regular international travel across the US and Europe.

 

Strong Plus

  • Has marketed into insurance, reinsurance or financial services. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, the Lloyd's market, banks or asset managers. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.

  • Experience marketing alongside a direct enterprise sales team with named accounts, including account-based marketing into a defined target list.

  • Has built or materially raised a brand in a category that needed defining rather than one that already existed.

  • Has run a flagship industry event presence and an executive speaking programme, and can judge which events are worth the money.

  • Analyst and media relations experience, and comfort with thought leadership built on proprietary data.

  • Has scaled a marketing function through a step change in growth expectations.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. AI-assisted content production, agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Research shows the best candidates rarely match a job description point for point. If you're excited about this role and believe you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything listed above.

Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


How you'll empower our tech and product leadership

You be a strategic partner and a vital force multiplier for our Chief Product Officer, Tom (CPrO) and incoming Chief Technology Officer (CTO). data.title: AIT & Electronics Technician

data.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Core data modelling: Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

  • Modelling at source: Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

  • Self-serve platform: Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

  • Agents as consumers: Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

  • Metrics that matter: Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

  • Answers, not just queries: Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

  • Standards: Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

 

What we’re looking for

  • You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

  • You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business.

  • Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

  • Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't.

  • Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query.

  • You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on.

  • Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked.

    What We Offer

    • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

    • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

    • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

    • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

    • Gym membership & wellness benefits

    • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

    • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

    • MacBook Pro + team kit

    • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


    Interview process

    We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

    1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

    2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

    3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

    4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

    5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email

Connect with us!

LinkedIn | Glassdoor | Indeed | FeeFo | Trustpilot | YouTube | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter | TikTok |

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content

  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.

💡 Why Subscriptions? 

  • An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship.
  • Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.
  • Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo,  DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity.
  • A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously.

🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here

We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:

  • Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.
  • Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?
  • Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.
  • Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.

If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.

🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles

  • Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

🙌 About You 

  • You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends.
  • What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work.
  • You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through.

These roles are based in our tech hub in London.

We're looking for a Senior National Account Manager to join our UKI team. In this role, you'll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our largest restaurant partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence.

 

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

 

You'll be joining the National Accounts team. Working with partners of this scale means you will often tackle challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, directly shaping the future of how we collaborate with the world's largest food brands.

 

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of major restaurant partners, managing weekly operational meetings and high-level performance reviews.

  • Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific goals, creating compelling narratives from complex data to show partners where and how they can improve.

  • Consultative Growth: Increase revenue and health metrics by advising partners on best practices for selection, pricing, and service levels.

  • Operational Training: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting.

  • Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional Commercial Managers to identify and prioritise growth opportunities across specific UK zones.

  • Marketing Integration: Work with restaurant marketing counterparts to design and deliver campaigns that create long-term value for both the partner and Deliveroo.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working with Deliveroo's Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 

  • Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a strategic partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology or marketplace environment.

  • Analytical Rigour: The ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive business decisions.

  • Communication & Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.

  • Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects.

     

Why Join Us?

 

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

data.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role

Exa is expanding to the EU and the UK and we are looking for an ambitious, proactive, and collaborative Field Marketer to partner closely with our regional team and build demand in this critical market. Companies big and small are making critical decisions about how to invest in AI and how their AI agents will retrieve information, and you will play a key role in how they discover Exa. As the first Field Marketer in EMEA, you will shape how buyers experience our brand and interact with our team, through highly strategic, and thoughtfully crafted events.

This is one of those rare, founding team member opportunities: you'll build the regional program from the ground up and inform so much beyond our event strategy; from messaging and overall brand presence at a pivotal time for Exa. This is an incredible fit for someone who sweats the details, lives to create world-class experiences, and obsesses over how to drive pipeline from every touchpoint. You will own the regional program, identify opportunities to build brand awareness and pipeline through a mix of high-hospitality and lead generating events including: executive dinners, networking receptions, hackathons, third-party sponsorships, partner events, and more. You'll partner strategically with Account Executives and SDRs to build an event plan that delivers coverage across your territory and key accounts.

Our bar is high and our north star is to establish Exa as a world-class brand. We’re a team that embraces learnings as opportunities to optimize future events and processes, while remaining focused on our pursuit to drive ever increasing pipeline. If this sounds exciting to you, we'd love to meet you!

This role is based in person in London, with regular travel across the EMEA and the occasional trip to our San Francisco HQ.

What You Will Own

Regional program strategy. Own the plan for your territory, deciding which formats, cities, audiences, and investments will meet our pipeline goals each quarter. Co-build the plan with input from sales and defend it with pipeline rationale. Success is measured by program quality and by pipeline sourced and influenced in the region.

End-to-end execution. Own every event from concept to post-event follow-up: sourcing venues, orchestrating vendors and production, managing invitations and the run of show, overseeing on-site execution, and sweating every detail. Success is measured by the number of qualified attendees and by nailing execution.

Sales partnership and account targeting alignment. Establish and maintain tight sales partnerships, align with sales to get the right personas and accounts to each event and create effective event playbooks that convert to pipeline. Success is measured by meetings generated and by the number of target accounts engaged through your programs.

Pipeline outcomes and follow-through. Own what happens during and after the event: ensuring timely lead handoff and building the follow-up sequence in partnership with SDRs, Lifecycle Marketing, and Marketing Ops. Success is measured by conversion from attendee to qualified opportunity.

Budget and vendors. Own your regional budget, vendor selection and negotiation, and cost per qualified lead. Success is measured by program impact per dollar.

AI-first operations. Use AI to compress operational timelines: invite-list development, personalized outreach at scale, vendor research, run-of-show generation, and post-event summarization. You'll run a serious regional program because the busywork is automated.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company, including ownership of a regional program rather than execution of someone else's.

  • Deeply committed to event craft: You can walk us through a run of show, tell us what you check at 4pm before a 6pm start, and describe the last thing that went wrong at an event and how you fixed it.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline: You have owned a pipeline number and can speak to cost per qualified lead.

  • Evidence of strong sales partnership: You can speak to how you've built strong partnerships with sales counterparts in similar roles, including how you manage reps who push for something you know isn't the right investment.

  • Deep understanding of the EMEA market: You have a finger on the pulse of the cultural nuances, best venues, vendors, and event tactics that will draw an audience of senior technical buyers here.

  • Meticulous event budget and timeline management: You have both budget and vendor negotiation experience.

  • Upholds a growth mindset: You embrace feedback as a lever to fuel growth and see learnings as an opportunity to optimize for next time.

  • Experience using AI to drive efficiencies: You use AI daily to remove operational load, and can show us how.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running events for a technical or developer audience alongside enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the program rather than inherited it.

  • Experience developing booth designs and strategies that drive lead generation.

  • Familiarity with event tech (registration, badge scanning, on-site capture) and how it connects to CRM.

  • Experience crafting executive roundtables or advisory dinners for senior technical leaders.

  • Experience building reports to track event performance.

Benefits

  • Health and wellness: Premium medical coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit tiered by location.

  • Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

  • Life at Exa: Our SF office serves lunch and dinner daily, with snacks, coffee, fresh bread from a local bakery, weekly milk tea, monthly picnics, and parties to celebrate the wins (and each other). You'll visit often.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs and thought leadership.

This is a role for someone who brings together brand ownership and PR/communications. You’ll have experience owning and shaping a B2B brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - alongside strong, hands-on PR and media experience.

You’ll have built that experience within B2B technology/SaaS, or in a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients. That combination is important: we need someone who is as comfortable thinking about our brand and positioning as they are shaping a story, working with journalists and building our reputation.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Owning our brand - shaping and evolving Goodlord’s positioning, messaging, identity and voice, and making sure we show up consistently and distinctively

  • Leading PR, media and corporate affairs - owning our day-to-day PR and media activity, building relationships with journalists, spotting and shaping stories, managing our external PR agency and leading our approach to regulatory, policy and reputation-related communications

  • Shaping our stories - turning complex industry, regulatory and technology topics into compelling narratives and thought leadership, working with senior leaders where needed

  • Leading content and SEO - setting the direction for our content and SEO specialists, helping them create useful, engaging work that supports our brand and wider business priorities

  • Leading creative and design - setting clear direction for our in-house designers and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord

  • Connecting brand to the business - partnering with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support our wider commercial goals

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand and PR/communications, gained within B2B technology/SaaS or a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients, or a mix of both!

  • Have owned and shaped a brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - rather than solely delivering brand campaigns or driving brand awareness

  • Have strong, hands-on PR and media experience, with a track record of building journalist relationships, shaping stories and delivering earned coverage

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have experience across corporate affairs, reputation management and thought leadership, including working with senior leaders on external communications

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors, with the judgement to set direction across content, SEO and creative

  • Are commercially minded, collaborative and enjoy having ownership while staying close to the work

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

  • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

  • L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

  • Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

  • Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

  • Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA

Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si

  • Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux

  • Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch

  • Les détails vous ennuient

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique

  • Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence

  • Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion

  • Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit

  • Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit

  • Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur

  • Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA

  • Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity

  • Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage

Processus de recrutement

  1. Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes)

  2. Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes)

  3. Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian)

  4. Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO)

  5. Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa

Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle.

Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés.

Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end.

At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth.

We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 1-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential.

We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto.

Your role is to help us find, select and invest in those companies.

Mission

Within Hexa Scale’s team (Thibault, Augustin & Samuel), you’ll participate in the deal-flow cycle to make 2/3 successful deals a year.

Outcomes

Deal-flow: guarantee volume and reactivity

  • Perform the first analysis of Inbound leads, and therefore guarantee a <48h contact to the entrepreneurs.

  • Identify new companies that fit our investment scope each week for reach out and ensure a strong volume generation at the top of our investment funnel, target: 30 identified companies

  • Help us to enhance our outbound tooling set-up (database, automations, scraping)

Research: help perform cutting edge market deep-dives

  • Perform research on sectors that we decide to deep-dive: mapping of actors, mapping of products and features, understanding of competitive landscape, understanding of funding status and exit potential, understanding of value-creation for customers and GTM structures.

Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?

 

Notre société grandit et évolue, dans ce contexte nous souhaitons renforcer notre équipe finance en accueillant un.e stagiaire en finance/contrôle de gestion. L'équipe se compose aujourd'hui de Laure Salle (DAF Ekimetrics France) et Dimitri Chendjou Fotso (Adjoint DAF Ekimetrics France).

 

Plus précisément vous aurez pour mission :

 

. Élaboration des indicateurs de gestion et tableaux de bord (P&L, Bilan, Cash-flow),

. Suivi de la trésorerie en lien avec l'équipe Finance et administration des ventes

. Préparation des analyses ad-hoc nécessaires dans le cadre des projets en-cours

. Construction des présentations pour le CODIR

. Aide au calcul du revenu du groupe Ekimetrics et de sa projection

. Assurer l’engagement des chefs de projet dans le suivi de la rentabilité via le déploiement dans l'ensemble des entités d'un processus hebdomadaire

 

Le profil et les compétences recherchées:

 

Vous suivez une formation supérieure « Grande École » ou équivalent avec une spécialisation en gestion et/ou finance

Vous souhaitez acquérir une vision transverse des métiers de l’entreprise

 

Compétences spécifiques :

· Formation comptabilité et contrôle de gestion

· Forte appétence pour Excel

· Anglais opérationnel

 

Qualités personnelles :

· Rigueur dans les rendus

· Vous êtes curieux

· Force de proposition

· Motivation / Enthousiasme

  

Notre processus recrutement

  • Un test technique sur Excel
  • Un entretien RH avec un(e) Talent Acquisition
  • Un entretien final avec Laure SALLES la Directrice Finance France
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :
 
·       Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
·       A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;
·       De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;
·       Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)
·       Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 
En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility
