data.description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Attraktive Aufgaben in einem international agierenden, wachsenden Familienunternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten 
  • 4 Wochen Remote Work aus dem EU Ausland
  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Gehaltsbänder für eine gerechte Unternehmenskultur
  • Monatlicher Zuschuss von 50€ für deine BAV
  • Teilnahme an jährlichen 360° Feedback-Loops mit klaren Aufstiegskriterien und einem individuellen Karrierepfad
  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag in einem Unternehmen, das Eigenverantwortung und persönliches Wachstum fördert
  • Im Bedarfsfall können Umzugskosten anteilig erstattet werden

Pourquoi ce poste est important ?

Chez Exotec, nous concevons et maintenons des systèmes robotiques de pointe qui transforment les entrepôts dans le monde entier. Chaque jour, notre technologie contribue à rendre les opérations plus sûres, plus rapides et moins exigeantes physiquement. En tant que Technicien de Maintenance, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bon fonctionnement de ces systèmes et offrir des performances exceptionnelles à nos clients.

Pourquoi vous apprécierez travailler chez nous ?

  • Travailler avec des technologies robotiques de dernière génération.
  • Rejoindre de petites équipes soudées où chacun a un réel impact.
  • Évoluer dans des environnements de travail modernes et propres.
  • Bénéficier d’une grande autonomie pour diagnostiquer les problèmes et trouver des solutions.

Vos missions

  • Assurer le fonctionnement optimal du système Skypod® et de notre flotte de robots.
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes mécaniques, électriques et logicielles.
  • Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les sites clients.
  • Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour résoudre des problématiques complexes.
  • Améliorer la fiabilité des systèmes et les performances clients.
  • Participer à la formation des clients et offrir une expérience de service d’excellence.

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Salaire annuel brut compétitif + prime d’équipe/poste + augmentation salariale complémentaire (%) selon l’organisation du temps de travail applicable et conformément à la convention collective + bonus annuel ExoBonus.
  • Tickets restaurant, RTT, mutuelle compétitive, prime vacances.
  • Organisation du travail du lundi au vendredi - 39h hebdomadaire. Travail de nuit et le week-end possible.
  • Horaires :
    • En horaires de journée (8h-17h30 : modulable)
  • Poste basé à Evreux (27)
  • Déplacements ponctuels possible en Normandie

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 ans d’expérience en maintenance industrielle, avec de solides compétences en diagnostic mécanique et électrique.
    • Connaissance pratique de la maintenance préventive et corrective sur :
      • systèmes de convoyage,
      • roulements,
      • courroies,
      • chaînes,
      • rouleaux,
      • moteurs,
      • variateurs,
      • capteurs,
      • actionneurs.

    • Capacité à lire des schémas électriques, surveiller les performances des systèmes et réaliser un premier niveau de diagnostic logiciel.
    • Calme et fiable, capable de résoudre rapidement les pannes, d’identifier les causes racines et de prendre des décisions sous pression.
    • Esprit curieux, sens du service client, goût du travail en équipe et excellente communication.

Processus de recrutement

Rejoignez-nous en seulement 2 semaines !

    1. Postulez en ligne.
    2. Notre objectif est de vous contacter sous 5 jours pour un premier échange téléphonique.
    3. Dans les 5 jours suivants, nous vous inviterons à visiter le site, rencontrer l’équipe, réaliser un exercice technique de diagnostic de panne et échanger avec le responsable du recrutement.
    4. Réception de votre proposition d’embauche dans les 4 jours suivant les entretiens.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi.

Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences.
En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.
Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

Your Role

You will join a dynamic Finance team of 7 people in an environment driven by continuous growth and international development.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, you will play a key role in ensuring accounting accuracy while actively contributing to key projects and transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will maintain accounting operations on NetSuite for 6 international entities and participate in group consolidation processes.

We are looking for someone with strong technical accounting expertise combined with an appetite for change, eager to drive or participate in major strategic projects within a scaling company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Accounting & Treasury Management:

  • Post bank entries and perform daily/monthly bank reconciliations.

  • Manage vendor invoices via our digital processing tool, directing them through approval workflows.

  • Prepare payment runs, perform accounts payable reconciliation, and manage vendor follow-ups/relations.

  • Perform accounts receivable matching and reconciliation.

  • Perform payroll accounting entry integration.

  • Apply analytical accounting principles across your perimeter.

  • Asset Management, Tax & Group Reporting:

  • Perform fixed asset accounting, tracking, and reconciliation.

  • Prepare monthly closing operations (cut-off entries, accruals, VAT, exchange variance analysis, etc.).

  • Prepare French tax declarations (DAS2, VAT, and other local taxes).

  • Manage US Sales Tax compliance

  • Contribute to monthly financial reporting and participate in the Group consolidation process.

  • Ensure daily maintenance of accounting ledgers in compliance with company rules, accounting standards, quality, and deadlines.

  • Support annual statutory audit processes.

  • Projects & Change Management:

  • Actively lead or participate in high-impact finance projects, process automation, and system enhancements.

  • Embrace and drive change to support the scaling of our international finance organization.


    • Required Qualifications

  • Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Degree in Accounting or Finance (e.g., DCG, DSCG, or equivalent).

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar accounting role within an international group or fast-paced environment.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite (familiarity with CSV imports, FAM module, Saved Searches, and multi-currency/multi-entity setups) is required.

  • Strong technical accounting expertise (Local GAAP, closing operations, fixed assets, French taxes).

  • Soft Skills & Mindset:

  • Appetite for Change & Project-Driven: You thrive in scaling, evolving environments and enjoy driving or contributing to major transformation projects.

  • Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success.

  • Language: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to interact effectively within a global team and environment.


    • Where you'll be
  • Based in Paris (75002), France.
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
  • Full time permanent contract position.
    • Who We Are
    At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.
     
    Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.

    Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.
    Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.

Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d'une carte de frais professionnels, remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will own our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

As a Business Development Intern, your main priorities center on qualifying and completing the onboarding journey with Asian sellers. After activation, you will grow sellers’ business including working with sellers to maximize product selection and acting as a trustworthy bridge between internal stakeholder teams and sellers to deliver the best e-commerce experience for customers on Back Market.

You will be able to contribute to overall business by leading BD enablement projects that unleash the potential of sellers to scale up.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Qualify and onboard new sellers to contribute to Back Market’s selection growth

  • Manage newly activated sellers through a hybrid approach of dedicated 1:1 account management and pooled coverage, focusing on Sellers GMV & Quality performance to ensure a profitable and healthy growth for both seller and Back Market

  • Partner with internal functional teams (quality, logistics, finance, legal etc) to support new sellers

  • Constantly explore top sellers on competitors' platforms with global supply origin, including Hong Kong/China/Asia, etc.

  • Support on BD seller communication, including 1) be part of the taskforce to lead on seller recruitment or education webinars; 2) developing Chinese/English content library of BD enablement materials

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-months internship

  • English and Mandarin are no-brainers (fully professional capability in English and Mandarin). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • Excellent in time management with great sense of priority and ownership

  • Detail-oriented and active listener

  • Good organization & communication skills

  • You have an analytical and critical thinking mind - strong use of insights for decision making

  • Abilities to work independently with highly self-motivation. Positive learning attitude is must-have

  • Interested in engaging with small to medium-sized businesses and e-commerce, you ideally have a previous experience in a related field

  • Experience in content creation and live broadcasting is a plus

  • Interested in fast-growing start-ups preferred

  • Salesforce, SQL, and/or Tableau experience is a plus, but readiness to learn a must

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement provided by your French school is required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Home assignment

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

  • • Paris-based Internship salary range, depending on study level €1.2K – €1.4K per month

Are you ready to join us?

The Trade-In service enables customers to sell their old devices (smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, Back Market’s network professional refurbishers. This is great for the consumer who can reclaim cash for their old device and prevent the accumulation of e-waste in our landfills. Trade-In is also a key pillar for Back Market as it facilitates the sourcing of tech devices to be refurbished and sold on our website.

BuyBulk is Back Market's centralized Trade-in service where a single professional processing partner receives, tests and grades all incoming devices on behalf of the refurbishers. Instead of each refurbisher individually sourcing and processing trade-in devices, BuyBulk handles the entire operational process and ships the tested devices in bulk. This service removes the sourcing burden and lets professionals focus on what they do best: refurbishing and selling.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

Play a key role in ensuring Buybulk performance reaches targets on a daily / weekly / monthly basis by:

  • Tracking and monitoring KPIs to help the team understand performance drivers and take relevant actions: you will support the team in regular reporting, one-off analyses on specific topics and continuous improvement of reporting and tools

  • Being in charge of key operational processes and checks to ensure a steady performance and customer satisfaction

Support the team on major projects - examples of projects and topics you could work on:

  • Improving efficiency through automation (simplify / automate processes, reportings, analyses, alerting …)

  • Build new or improve existing processes, tools and reports on ad-hoc projects (quality control, customer care, pricing, …)

  • Participate in structuring large projects by identifying opportunities (benchmark, research, …), setting up action plans, identifying stakeholders (within teams such business development, marketing or product), defining timelines and success factors and regularly following up on progress

  • Ideally you have previous experience (internship, freelance, apprenticeship) as a business analyst, country or category manager, operations manager (logistics, customer care, …), seller success manager, investment banking or consulting intern/junior and you are looking for a hands-on experience allowing you to have a concrete impact on the business.

Le poste

InsideBoard est la plateforme d'IA dédiée à la conduite du changement. Nous accompagnons l'adoption et la performance chez les plus grandes entreprises mondiales (Stellantis, General Motors, Michelin, La Poste, Pernod Ricard, et d'autres).
En tant que Solution Engineer, vous êtes le pont technique entre nos clients et la plateforme : vous participez aux ateliers client, vous captez les besoins, puis vous utilisez le développement assisté par IA (Claude Code, Windsurf et notre outillage d'agents interne) pour configurer, intégrer et étendre la plateforme InsideBoard, souvent dans la même semaine.

Ce n'est pas un poste d'ingénieur logiciel classique, et vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser toutes les technologies de notre stack. Vous orchestrez des agents IA sur un écosystème interne bien documenté (surface d'API, automatisation n8n, conventions pensées pour les agents).
L'IA écrit la majeure partie du code ; votre travail consiste à savoir ce qu'elle fait, à vérifier qu'elle fait la bonne chose, et à l'arrêter quand ce n'est pas le cas. Et vous portez la relation client sur le volet technique.

Vos missions

Face au client (environ 50 %)

  • Animer des ateliers de cadrage et de spécification avec des clients grands comptes (en français et en anglais), du kickoﬀ aux comités de pilotage (COPIL).
  • Transformer les réunions en livrables actionnables : spécifications fonctionnelles, matrices de statut, wireframes, guides d'intégration, guides utilisateur, comptes rendus avec décisions validées.
  • Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation.
  • Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production.

Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %)

  • Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags.
  • Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack.
  • Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes.
  • Brancher des fonctionnalités LLM pour les clients : synthèses de performance générées par IA, pipelines OCR, bases de connaissances RAG, conception de prompts d'agents.
Le profil recherché

Vous n'avez pas besoin de connaître toutes les technologies que nous utilisons. Il vous faut assez de profondeur technique pour superviser une IA qui les connaît : comprendre son plan, poser les bonnes questions, repérer quand elle dérive, et valider le résultat avant qu'il n'atteigne un client.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que chercheur postdoctoal, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez curiosité scientifique avec un intérêt pour l’articulation entre problématiques de recherche fondamentale et problématiques indus-trielles.

Le centre SPIN est l’un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne dédié à la recherche en génie des procédés et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L’activité du centre SPIN s’inscrit dans le périmètre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Société (UMR 5600). Vous développerez votre activité de recherche au sein du département « Procédés de Manipulation de la Matière Granulaire » (PMMG) qui concentre divers expertises scientifiques sur les procédés de transformation et la caractérisa-tion de matériaux granulaires à partir d’approches expérimentales et numériques, ainsi qu’à travers différents champs disciplinaires allant de la géométrie mathématique à la chimie minérale en pas-sant par la physique des écoulements complexes. L’activité du centre SPIN, comme du départe-ment PMMG, est caractérisée par une forte interdisciplinarité ainsi que par de nombreuses collabo-rations avec d’autres institutions de recherche et d’enseignement en Europe et dans le monde, et profite de nombreux contrats avec des partenaires industriels.

La matière granulaire est un état de la matière particulier qui peine à être décrit par les lois de com-portement qui s’appliquent habituellement aux fluides, ou aux solides. Cependant une vaste majo-rité des matières premières transformées dans de nombreux secteurs industriels, ou des produits manufacturés, se présentent sous la forme de particules solides (grains de poudre, agglomérats, granulés, comprimés, etc..). La complexité de la dynamique de ces solides divisés émerge du grand nombre de particules solides concernées. En particulier dans le cas de particules solides transpor-tées dans une conduite de transport pneumatique, où l’écoulement d’un gaz le long d’une con-duite entraine les particules solides, les interactions avec les parois solides sont le siège de nom-breux procédés physico-chimiques. Au-delà des collisions élastiques qui entraînent le rebond de la majorité des particules solides sur les parois, des processus de fragmentation, d’arrachement de charges, d’échauffement local, etc. sont susceptibles de provoquer des transformations de la ma-tière transportée. Dans certains cas, la formation de dépôts sur les parois peut être observée et affecte négativement les performances du procédé de transport.

Le travail attendu sera de mettre en place un montage expérimental capable d’étudier les proces-sus responsables de la formation de ces enrochements à partir de mesures de pression, de débit, de charges électrostatiques, d’observation par microscopie, de caractérisation granulométrique etc. Différentes poudres modèles pourront être utilisées afin de reproduire les observations d’enrochement reportées dans la litérature. L’équipe d’encadrement sera constituée d’enseignants-chercheurs du centre SPIN ainsi que d’ingénieurs R&D de notre partenaire industriel ORANO.

ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

data.description:
Context:

This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources.

Objective:

To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size).

Description:

Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.

Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria.

Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms.

Starting date : 01/01/2027


Profile and application:

PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab).

References:

[1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib., doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633.

[2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib., 453, 328-354.

LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob

LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon)

Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight)

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.


Accountabilities
  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

 

We are seeking a high-energy, results-driven Strategic Account Manager (SME) to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to become a founding member of our growing Airwallex team in France, specifically focused on scaling our high-growth SME accounts. You will be instrumental in driving expansion, maximising Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and ensuring deep product adoption across a strategic portfolio of 50+ SME accounts. If you are passionate about product, revenue, and impact—and enjoy solving real-world business challenges using technical solutions—this role offers you the chance to make a tangible impact and grow with one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech companies.

 

What you’ll do

 

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio of SME accounts recently signed by our Sales team. Your mission will be to drive expansion through upsell and cross-sell strategies, maximise NRR, and ensure adoption of Airwallex’s product suite. You will work as a critical bridge between customers and our product teams, translating client needs into innovative product solutions and helping to shape our go-to-market approach in France.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Drive upsell and cross-sell strategy for your portfolio to exceed quarterly expansion targets and revenue KPIs.

  • Become a power-user of the Airwallex platform and act as a product advisor, recommending optimal API configurations or feature sets based on clients' technical setups.

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of 50+ accounts, implementing a structured framework to identify and capitalize on high-impact growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate customer requirements into actionable product roadmaps, advocating for client needs in the French market.

  • Help build and refine the Account Management "playbook" for France, ensuring scalable onboarding and activation processes.

  • Proactively monitor account health and product usage metrics to mitigate churn and ensure long-term platform loyalty.

 

Who you are

 

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

Minimum qualifications:

 

  • Native or bilingual fluency in French and professional proficiency in English.

  • At least 5 years of Account Management or Sales experience managing SME or Mid-Market portfolios.

  • Deep understanding of Fintech or Payments (card issuing, acquiring, FX, or global payment rails is a significant plus).

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales or upsell targets, with a revenue-driven mindset.

  • Strong operational rigor with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across 50+ accounts.

  • Product-first mindset and comfortable discussing API documentation, payment flows, and technical integrations with both CFOs and technical stakeholders.

 

Preferred qualifications:

 

  • Self-starter with a problem-solving mindset and a passion for building new markets from the ground up.

  • Experience advocating for customer needs to influence product development.

  • Prior experience in a fast-growing or startup fintech environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex customer portfolios and prioritize for greatest impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

We are growing! We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury for our Paris office.  

About CXG: 

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.  

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.  

We are passionate about delivering impact. 

Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

Overview

We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury, based in our Paris office. This is a strategic and highly commercial role for an entrepreneurial automotive expert who can leverage a strong senior network, create and convert new business opportunities, and help CXG expand its position with leading premium and luxury automotive brands.

What you will be doing

Reporting to CXG Chief Customer Officer, you will lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to, the following:

 1.    Automotive Business Development Leadership

  • Lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, with direct ownership of new client acquisition and market expansion.
  • Update and maintain a compelling Automotive value proposition that leverages CXG's capabilities, methodologies, resources, differentiators, and data, and addresses the priorities of stakeholders across the industry and regions, including brands, importers, distributors, and showroom management.
  • Promote the value proposition internally and externally and constantly search for new ways to improve it.
  • Serve as CXG's internal and external automotive industry expert and the key point of contact for automotive projects, strategic client discussions, and new business opportunities.
  • Develop and execute a clear commercial strategy to acquire new automotive clients, personally leveraging an established senior network to generate qualified opportunities, build a strong pipeline, and convert prospects into sustainable revenue.
  • Ensure all relevant parties are included in proposal preparation, so the most powerful offers are presented to prospects while taking current and future operational capacity into account.
  • Establish the annual business plan, including revenue ambitions, priority accounts, pipeline targets, key commercial actions, and market development initiatives.
  • Monitor the commercial performance of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, including pipeline development, conversion, and revenue growth, and provide clear reporting to management and the Executive Committee.

2.    Client Development and Internal Expertise

  • New client acquisition sits at the heart of this role. It is the primary criterion and the main measure of success.
  • Create measurable value for both prospects and existing clients by connecting their business priorities with CXG's full range of capabilities.
  • For existing clients, work closely with the CSMs responsible for automotive accounts and join meetings at key milestones, including the presentation of deliverables, discussions about account growth opportunities, and conversations on current client challenges. Use your expertise to strengthen the client dialogue, help resolve issues, and maximize additional business opportunities.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert for the CSMs managing automotive accounts, sharing relevant market, client, and industry knowledge to strengthen their credibility and effectiveness.
  • Coach CSMs to identify whitespace, develop account expansion plans, and build stronger relationships with senior client stakeholders. Join client meetings whenever your expertise can increase the value of the discussion or support the conversion of an opportunity.
  • Advise clients on CXG's Automotive value proposition, and ensure discussions cover our Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting capabilities.
  • Own the business development effort for the Automotive Industry practice, from market mapping and opportunity creation through proposal development, negotiation, and conversion.
  • Develop and nurture CXG's visibility and credibility across relevant automotive markets through active networking, industry events, thought leadership, and white papers.

Requirements

What you will bring along

This role requires a genuine passion for the automotive and luxury industries.

You should also have the below:

  • Master's degree in Luxury Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a Business School or similar institution.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the automotive sector, with significant exposure to consulting, marketing, sales, or business development in the premium or luxury segment.
  • Fluent English is mandatory, with German as a plus and French as a nice-to-have.
  • An extensive and active network of senior decision-makers across the premium and luxury automotive sector, with the credibility and relationship-building skills to open doors, create qualified opportunities, and position CXG's value proposition. This is a core requirement for the role.
  • A strong and demonstrable business development track record, including originating opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and winning new clients or expanding strategic accounts.
  • Demonstrable experience developing strategic and business plans.
  • Deep knowledge of the premium and luxury automotive market, its commercial ecosystem, client priorities, and the trends and forces shaping the industry's development.
  • Good understanding of corporate finance and measures of performance.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Positive and outgoing personality.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, polished, persuasive, and diplomatic, with experience in presentations and proposal writing.
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • A strong consulting approach and the ability to coach client-facing teams, translate industry expertise into commercial opportunities, and influence senior stakeholders.

You will work hand in hand with our Growth team, which is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP).

 

You will be working on highly scalable mobile games, played by millions of people. You will be part of a small and high-performing team and will have the opportunity to grow your skills by hiring A-Players all around the world.
